query: INSERT INTO public.jobs (engine_key, process_instance_key, execution_key, job_type, status, payload, retries, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $6, $5, $7, NOW(), NOW())
UPDATE public.jobs SET status = $3, completed_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = (SELECT engine_key FROM public.process_instances WHERE id = $1) AND engine_key = $2
UPDATE public.executions SET current_element_id = $1, status = $4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = (SELECT engine_key FROM public.process_instances WHERE id = $2) AND engine_key = $3

INSERT INTO public.variables (engine_key, process_instance_key, data, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (process_instance_key) DO UPDATE SET data = EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
INSERT INTO public.variables (engine_key, process_instance_key, data, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)

SELECT j.execution_key, j.process_instance_key, pi.id AS process_instance_id, e.current_element_id, j.status, j.retries FROM public.jobs j JOIN public.executions e ON e.process_instance_key = j.process_instance_key AND e.engine_key = j.execution_key JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.engine_key = j.process_instance_key WHERE j.process_instance_key = $1 AND j.engine_key = $2 FOR UPDATE OF j
INSERT INTO public.executions (engine_key, process_instance_key, current_element_id, status, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $6, $7, $4, $5)
SELECT id, status FROM public.process_instances WHERE status IN ($2, $3) ORDER BY ended_at LIMIT $1
UPDATE public.process_instances SET status = $1, ended_at = $2 WHERE id = $3
UPDATE public.executions SET status = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = $2 AND engine_key = $3

SELECT e.engine_key, pi.id AS process_instance_id, e.process_instance_key, e.current_element_id, e.status, e.is_active, e.parent_execution_key, e.path_id, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM public.executions e JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.engine_key = e.process_instance_key WHERE e.engine_key = $1 AND e.is_active = $2
SELECT pd.parsed_graph FROM public.process_definitions pd JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.process_definition_id = pd.id WHERE pi.id = $1
UPDATE public.executions SET current_element_id = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = $2 AND engine_key = $3
UPDATE public.executions SET status = $3, is_active = $4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = $1 AND engine_key = $2

SELECT a.id, pi.id AS process_instance_id, a.task_key, a.user_id, a.action, a.old_data, a.new_data, a.created_at FROM public.audit_logs a JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.engine_key = a.process_instance_key WHERE pi.id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "public"."process_instances" x WHERE "engine_key" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

SELECT j.engine_key, j.payload, j.retries, j.execution_key, pi.id AS process_instance_id, j.status, j.created_at FROM public.jobs j JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.engine_key = j.process_instance_key WHERE j.job_type = $1 AND j.status = $3 AND (j.locked_until IS NULL OR j.locked_until < NOW()) LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
UPDATE public.executions SET status = $1, current_element_id = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE process_instance_key = $3 AND engine_key = $4
SELECT data FROM public.variables WHERE process_instance_key = $1

SELECT pi.id, pi.process_definition_id, pi.status, pi.started_by, pi.transaction_scope_id, pi.started_at, pi.ended_at, pi.tenant_id, pi.business_key, pd.process_key, pd.process_name, pd.version FROM public.process_instances pi LEFT JOIN public.process_definitions pd ON pd.id = pi.process_definition_id WHERE pi.id = $1
SELECT pd.parsed_graph, pd.id AS process_definition_id FROM public.process_definitions pd JOIN public.process_instances pi ON pi.process_definition_id = pd.id WHERE pi.id = $1

SELECT permission FROM public.process_permissions WHERE process_key = $1 AND grantee_type = $3 AND grantee_id = $2 UNION SELECT pp.permission FROM public.process_permissions pp JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.roles_id = pp.grantee_id WHERE pp.process_key = $1 AND pp.grantee_type = $4 AND ur.user_id = $2
SELECT data FROM public.variables WHERE process_instance_key = (SELECT engine_key FROM process_instances WHERE id = $1)

SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "public"."executions" x WHERE "engine_key" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x
